timing_scope: Warm prefix, TTFT and subsequent token_ms means. Setup excluded; profiling, dumps and memory hooks disabled.
telemetry_scope: Before/after host captures; battery is a proxy, frequency snapshots are not execution-window averages. Frequency controls were not changed.

checks.metric_scope: Warm request latency; excludes setup, dumps and profiling. Ratio is the median of paired round mean-latency ratios.
checks.interpretation: A threshold crossing flags capacity-sensitive timings; repeat under comparable clocks and temperatures to confirm.
